notes: Group B re-check of stored NL competitors; no web searches made. Price corrections: Digitale Menukaart Menu is EUR 12/month (stored 1,200; Menu has no online ordering, only Bestellen EUR 39 does); FoodTruck POS Starter is EUR 12.99/month (stored 1,299); Bestelly Compleet is EUR 59/month (stored 0). Foodticket states its price only per day (EUR 1,50 per dag), so it is recorded with period 'day' - the stored 45.63/month was a derived figure that is not on the page. FoodTruck POS is not_relevant: QR ordering only in the queue at the truck, no ordering before arriving. Vev shows USD only, even on its Dutch pricing page; its pricing page does not say which plan includes food ordering. Jamezz qualifies as food_truck through its events/festivals page (food stands), not a food-truck page. Bestelly and iButler are restaurant tools (nearest_local); NL already has 4+ eligible food-truck tools, so under rule 2 a reviewer may leave them out. iButler offline: the only offline sentence is about its till (Kassa ... offline modus), so it is recorded as not_mentioned per the no-tills rule. Several page-reader answers were partly translated; only text the reader marked as quoted Dutch was used.
